generator_cmd: printf %s "$plain" | xxd -p -c0 | tr a-f A-F | sed 's/^/obase=95; ibase=16; /' | BC_LINE_LENGTH=0 bc | tr -s ' ' '\n' | grep . | awk '{printf "%c", $1+32}'  # GNU bc radix-95 digit groups -> chr(d+32)
oracle_cmd:
.venv/bin/python -I -c "import sys;from Crypto.Util.number import long_to_bytes;t=sys.stdin.read().rstrip('\n');n=0
for c in t: n=n*95+ord(c)-32
print(long_to_bytes(n).decode())"  # pycryptodome long_to_bytes over the radix-95 digits
